facts.text: Missing or None retries means three retries; explicit zero disables retries.
The legacy backend accepts at most five retries; larger values must be rejected.
Retries count additional operations, not the initial operation.
The upgraded backend accepts at most eight retries; the legacy limit is obsolete.
Retry delays double from one second and stop growing at four seconds to bound recovery latency.
